name: com.mapmylot/lots
title: MapMyLot
description: Land lot outlines, size and planning and hazard facts for AU, NZ, Canada and the UK.

tools.name: mml_find_lot
tools.description:
Finds the land lot for an address, lot/plan, UK postcode, INSPIRE ID or coordinates.
    Returns the lot's MapMyLot id (row_id), lot/plan, area, perimeter, a point inside it, its
    outline as GeoJSON, a link to view it on mapmylot.com, and the data sources. In hosts that
    show apps the lot is also drawn on a map. Each new lot counts toward the account's daily
    MapMyLot lookups. Requires a free MapMyLot account.

query.description: A street address, a lot/plan (QLD and NSW, e.g. 2/RP213261 or Lot 2 DP236756), a UK postcode, 'INSPIRE ID <number>' (England and Wales), or decimal coordinates 'lat, lon'
query.title: Query

tools.name: mml_coverage
tools.description:
Lists the areas MapMyLot covers, what each accepts (lot/plan, street address, postcode,
    coordinates), which planning and hazard layers are loaded, and the daily limits for each
    plan. Works without sign-in.

country.description: Optional filter: AU, NZ, CA or UK, or an area code such as qld
country.title: Country

tools.name: mml_lot_facts
tools.description:
Returns facts about a lot by its row_id: area, perimeter, frontage, traditional
    custodians, a 0-100 constraint score, each planning and hazard layer checked on the lot
    (present or not, value, share of the lot), the unconstrained area, how its size compares
    with the suburb, distances to the coast, parks, water and transmission lines, elevation,
    and whether boundary files exist. A lot whose report the account bought has every answer,
    as on Pro. Layers checked on the lot but not included on the account's plan are listed in
    locked_layers; a locked layer is not absent. Spends no lookup.

row_id.description: The lot's row_id, as returned by the lot search or in the list of purchased reports
row_id.title: Row Id

tools.name: mml_build_facts
tools.description:
Returns the facts about a lot that bear on building: area, frontage, zone (where zoning
    is loaded), planning and hazard constraints, unconstrained area, and slope and fall. The
    result is facts only, with no ruling on what can be built, and carries a caveat that the
    council decides. Spends no lookup.

row_id.description: The lot's row_id, as returned by the lot search or in the list of purchased reports
row_id.title: Row Id

tools.name: mml_report_link
tools.description:
Returns a permanent link to the MapMyLot PDF report for a lot when the account has bought
    that report or has a Pro plan; otherwise how the report is obtained. With no row_id, lists
    the reports this account has bought. Spends no lookup.

row_id.description: The lot's row_id, as returned by the lot search. Without it, the account's purchased reports are listed
row_id.title: Row Id

tools.name: mml_compare_lots
tools.description:
Returns side-by-side facts for 2 to 10 lots: one row per lot with the same facts as the
    lot facts result, or that lot's error. Rows stay in the order given, or follow a requested
    sort (by area, frontage, layers found, constraint score and so on); sorted_by states the
    order used. The result is facts only, with no ranking of which lot is better. Each new lot
    counts toward the day's lookups. Requires a MapMyLot Pro plan.

lots.description: 2 to 10 lots: row_ids returned by the lot search, or addresses, lot/plans or coordinates
lots.title: Lots

saved.description: Compares the account's saved lots instead (up to 10, newest first)
saved.title: Saved

sort.description: The facts the user asked to order the rows by, in turn, each with a direction, for example fewest layers_present first, then largest area_m2. Without it, the rows stay in the order given
sort.title: Sort

direction.description: asc: smallest or fewest first; desc: largest or most first
direction.title: Direction

tools.name: mml_saved_lots
tools.description:
Lists the lots this account has saved on MapMyLot (the site's shortlist), newest first,
    with the stored fields and a link to each. Returns no lot facts. Spends no lookup.

tools.name: mml_save_lot
tools.description:
Saves a lot to the account's saved lots on MapMyLot, with an optional note. Saving the
    same lot again changes nothing. Saved lots are removed on mapmylot.com. Spends no lookup.

row_id.description: The lot's row_id, as returned by the lot search or in the list of purchased reports
row_id.title: Row Id

label.description: Optional short note to save with the lot
label.title: Label

tools.name: mml_watch
tools.description:
Watches a lot, or the suburb it is in. MapMyLot emails the account holder when the public
    data about it changes, at most once a day. Watching the same lot or suburb again changes
    nothing. Requires a MapMyLot Pro plan.

row_id.description: The lot's row_id, as returned by the lot search or in the list of purchased reports
row_id.title: Row Id

scope.description: lot: this lot; suburb: the suburb this lot is in
scope.title: Scope

tools.name: mml_watches
tools.description:
Lists the lots and suburbs this account watches, each with its watch id and whether it is
    active or paused.

tools.name: mml_unwatch
tools.description: Stops a watch by its watch id. MapMyLot sends no more emails about that lot or suburb.

watch_id.description: The watch id, as listed in the account's watches
watch_id.title: Watch Id
